description: This file implements the recovery flow UI for the Notesnook application, including multiple recovery methods (key, backup, reset), user authentication, and finalization steps, utilizing React components, hooks, and external modules for handling user data, backup, and navigation.

classes.name: Recovery
classes.description: Main component managing the recovery process flow, handling routing and user authentication.

classes.name: RecoveryForm
classes.description: Reusable form component for recovery steps, managing form state, validation, and submission.

methods.name: getRouteComponent
methods.description: Returns the component corresponding to a recovery route.

methods.name: useAuthenticateUser
methods.description: Custom hook to authenticate user based on code and userId query parameters.

methods.name: openURL
methods.description: Opens a URL in the same window.

methods.name: isSessionExpired
methods.description: Checks if the user session has expired based on configuration.
